name: Video server
kid: The video lives here, on a computer in one of the cupboards. The video company keeps copies of popular videos in lots of places, so none of them is ever too far away.
nerd: A CDN cache server: the video app runs in a container and serves the segment from memory or SSD; only cache misses go further, back to the origin.

2010.kid: The video lives here, on a computer in one of the cupboards. The video company keeps copies of popular videos in a few big cities, so the nearest one is further away than today’s.
2010.nerd: A CDN cache server in 2010: Linux and a cache program straight on the hardware, with hot video in RAM and the rest on spinning disks; only cache misses go further, back to the origin.
